brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Cipros 20 Association on Dyslipidemia Treatment
official_title: Phase III, National, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind Clinical Trial, to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Cipros 20 Association on the Dyslipidemia Treatment
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of Cipros 20 association in the treatment of dyslipidemia treatment.
